thesis: Frozen IPS v2 should improve the economic quality of an independent approved XAU alpha by filtering XAU M1 trades to those preceded by same-direction persistence evidence.

filter_rule.keep_M1_trade_if: there exists at least one frozen IPS BUY event with score>=65 and 0 < (M1_entry_ts - IPS_entry_ts) <= 3600000 ms

development_scope.reason: IPS used 2018-2019 for weight selection and 2020-2024 are already exposed/diagnostic or confirmatory for the IPS genealogy.

base_reproduction_gate.rule: If base reproduction fails, do not evaluate IPS-filter PnL.

decision.PASS_GATE_A: base reproduction PASS and every Gate A criterion passes
decision.INCONCLUSIVE_SUPPORT: base reproduction PASS but filtered trades < 8
decision.REJECTED: base reproduction PASS, sample minimum met, and any hard Gate A criterion fails
decision.BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY: exact base reproduction cannot be achieved from recovered frozen rules/data
decision.no_rescue: Any change to filter window, IPS threshold, M1 rules or exit creates a new descendant campaign.

next_if_pass: Freeze filtered strategy and independent parity; only then preregister/open a 2025 validation slice.
next_if_not_pass: Do not open 2025-2026. Preserve M1 and IPS parent states unchanged.
